Please check Moodle before the class for the outline and contents of this course.
If you want to take this course, you must attend the first class.
This seminar is held in person. The proportion of English in this class is as follows.
(1) Language spoken by the teacher: 80% (I will explain the contents mainly in English.)
(2) Texts: 100%
(3) Language spoken by students (presentation, discussion, and Q&A): 80% (You can use English anytime in the class. For Japanese students, I expect all of you to use English in class.)
(4) Language for written assignments: 50% (You can write your paper in English.)

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本講義は政治を考える上で基礎となる概念や視角を取り上げ、その成り立ちと有効性、問題点と限界などを検討し、受講者自身が政治について考える力を身につけることを目的とする。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This lecture will focus on concepts and perspectives fundamental to thinking about politics, examining the origins, validity, problems, and limitations of these concepts and perspectives to help students acquire the ability to consider politics for themselves.
